name: TGS-2023036088 Lab 07 - Orchestrate the End-to-End SocialPost and YouTube Release

parameters.jsCode: for (const i of items) { const j=i.json; j.idempotency_key=j.idempotency_key||`${j.run_id||'RUN'}:${j.asset_id||'MASTER'}:${j.version||'v1'}:youtube`; const approved=j.qa_status==='PASS'&&j.approval_status==='APPROVED'&&j.approval_hash===j.payload_hash; const duplicate=Boolean(j.external_id||j.already_committed); j.release_status=!approved?'BLOCKED_APPROVAL':duplicate?'BLOCKED_DUPLICATE':'READY'; } return items;

for (const i of items) { const j=i.json; if(j.release_status!=='READY'){j.dry_run_result=j.release_status; continue;} j.endpoint='https://socialmediapost.tertiaryinfotech.com/api/upload'; j.method='POST'; j.authorization='Apikey <N8N_CREDENTIAL>'; j.form={video:'@vertical-master-v1.mp4',title:j.title,user:j.user,'platform[]':'youtube'}; j.privacy=j.privacy||'private'; j.synthetic_media=Boolean(j.synthetic_media); j.dry_run=true; j.dry_run_result='DRY_RUN_ACCEPTED'; } return items;

for (const i of items) { const j=i.json; j.publication_log={idempotency_key:j.idempotency_key,status:j.dry_run_result||j.release_status,platform:'youtube',privacy:j.privacy||'private',external_id:null,committed:false,recorded_at:new Date().toISOString()}; } return items;

parameters.content:
## Lab 07: Orchestrate the End-to-End SocialPost and YouTube Release

**Input:** data/mock-data.xlsx

**Output:** end-to-end-workflow.json, publishing-queue.xlsx and socialpost-request-preview.json

**Acceptance:** The n8n run reaches DRY_RUN_ACCEPTED once, records the SocialPost payload, blocks the duplicate key, and does not expose a credential or publish publicly.

TRAINING SAFETY: synthetic data; credentials remain in n8n; external publishing stays dry-run/private until trainer authorization.

nodes.name: Live SocialPost Upload (Disabled)
nodes.notes: Trainer enables only after configuring an n8n HTTP Header Auth credential named SocialPost API Key and changing the approved run from dry-run.
